text: {"memo": "Meta Platforms delivered strong performance in FY2024, with revenue reaching $164.5\u202fbn, up from $134.9\u202fbn in FY2023, representing roughly a 22% year\u2011over\u2011year increase. Net income rose to $62.4\u202fbn from $39.1\u202fbn, a roughly 60% jump, while operating income improved to $69.4\u202fbn from $46.8\u202fbn, about a 48% rise. Diluted EPS climbed to $23.86 from $14.87, and operating cash flow increased to $91.3\u202fbn from $71.1\u202fbn. These results lifted key margins: net income margin expanded to roughly 38% in FY2024 from 29% in FY2023, operating margin rose to about 42% from 35%, and operating cash\u2011flow margin improved to roughly 56% from 53%. The company\u2019s robust profitability and cash generation underscore its dominant position in the digital advertising ecosystem. View: META remains a high\u2011quality growth play with solid cash conversion, but valuation concerns persist amid macro uncertainty."}
